### The Books at the Judgment
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/the-books-at-the-judgment
Passage: Revelation 13:8
Points:
- Believers' eternal salvation is securely guaranteed because their names are recorded in the Lamb's book of life.
- Entrance into heaven rests entirely upon the sacrifice of the slain Lamb, not human merit or good deeds.
- At the final judgment, the records of believers' lives serve as public evidence confirming their genuine faith and union with Christ.
- Even for someone with a lifetime of sin, like the repentant thief, God's transformative grace will be openly displayed.
- Christians can live daily with confidence that God will finish the good work He began in them.
